**Which file to download**

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (most PCs) | `NicoReader-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows on ARM (Snapdragon X, Surface Pro 11) | `NicoReader-windows-arm64-setup.exe` |
| macOS 10.15 or later (Intel and Apple Silicon) | `NicoReader-macos.dmg` |
| Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint | `NicoReader-linux-x64.deb` |
| Linux: other distributions | `NicoReader-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

To use it on Windows without installing anything, take the zip.

The installers aren't signed yet: the first time, Windows SmartScreen asks for "More info" → "Run anyway", and macOS for System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway". Details in the [README](https://github.com/nicgnello-cyber/NicoReader#installing) ([italiano](https://github.com/nicgnello-cyber/NicoReader/blob/main/README.it.md#installarlo)).
